_about: Mimi's moments and observations. The format is explained at the top of brie.json.
Mimi is shy: she never comes close to a stranger by herself. A calm choice always helps her trust you;
a sudden one never does, and she leaves. Looking at her quietly (Look around) helps too.

calm: Mimi's eyes close halfway, and she purrs very softly.
sudden: Mimi's ears go flat. She slips away without a sound.
other: Mimi watches you for a moment, then looks back at the window.

pages: Mimi is watching you from across the room. Her blue eyes don't blink.

reply: Mimi's blue eyes stay on you, unblinking, and then, slowly, she lowers her head.
Mimi's ears go flat, and she slips off the sill and out of sight in a single movement.
Mimi watches you look away and, after a long moment, looks away too.

pages: High on the bookcase, Mimi tucks her paws under her chest.
Up there, nobody can bother her.

reply: Mimi's tail curls round her paws, and she settles back into her high corner, relieved.

choices.text: Stand up to see her better
reply: Mimi's eyes widen, and she is gone from the shelf before you are on your feet.

pages: Mimi has come a little closer. She pretends she hasn't.

reply: Mimi takes one more small step closer, very slowly, her eyes on your hands.
Mimi flinches back so fast she nearly knocks the cushion over, then vanishes into the bed.
Mimi stops, pretends she has not moved at all, and stays exactly where she is.

pages: Mimi looks at you and slowly closes her eyes.

reply: Mimi's eyes open again, slowly, and she gives you the smallest, most secret blink.
Mimi's ears flatten, and she slips off to a quieter corner without a sound.

pages: Mimi sits by the window and watches the city lights with you.

reply: Mimi's ears turn towards the lights, and she sits a little closer to the glass, next to you.
Mimi jerks her head away from your pointing finger and retreats behind the lamp.

pages: Mimi comes over and sniffs the tip of your shoe.
Then she sits down nearby, very straight.

reply: Mimi stretches her neck and sniffs your fingers, just once, then sits back down, very straight.
Mimi bolts out of reach and hides under the sideboard, and does not come out for a long while.
Mimi watches you, still sitting straight, and seems to decide you are harmless for now.

pages: Mimi climbs onto your table without a sound and curls up by your cup.

reply: Mimi leans into your fingers, and her eyes close halfway, her purr barely audible.
Mimi tucks her paws under and sleeps on, close to your cup, her tail over her nose.
Mimi's ears go back at the clink, and she slips off the table and away without a sound.

pages: Mimi steps onto your lap, turns around twice and falls asleep.
Nobody moves for a long while.

reply: Mimi's breathing slows, and she stays asleep on your lap, very still and very content.
Mimi's purr deepens under your hand, and she curls tighter, eyes shut.
Mimi opens one eye, watches the book come up, and sighs, but she doesn't move.

pages: Two blue eyes are watching you from the top of the bookcase. When you look up, they disappear.

reply: Mimi's eyes reappear, very slowly, at the top of the bookcase, watching you read.
Mimi's head stays up on the shelf a moment longer, then her eyes slowly close.
Mimi's eyes vanish instantly. The top of the bookcase is empty again.

pages: The tip of a dark tail hangs over the edge of the sideboard. It swishes, once.

reply: The tail swishes once more, then goes quiet, as if Mimi were thinking it over.
The tail twitches, then slowly tucks itself out of sight behind the sideboard.
The tail vanishes at once. There is nothing over the sideboard edge now.
Mimi bolts from behind the sideboard, and you hear her running off, quite unseen.

pages: Mimi watches your hands as you lift your cup. When you put it down, she relaxes a little.

reply: Mimi's eyes follow the cup down, and she visibly relaxes, her tail lying flat.
Mimi watches your hands settle, and her ears turn slightly towards you.
Mimi's ears flatten at the clink, and she slips away into the shadows.

pages: In the darkest corner of the room, two blue eyes catch the lamplight.

choices.text: Turn your chair a little away
reply: Mimi's eyes stay on the lamplight, and she edges very slightly out of its shadow.
Mimi blinks back, slowly, and her eyes glow a little in the lamplight.
Mimi's ears twitch towards your voice, and she blinks once, pleased to have been greeted.
Mimi's eyes vanish from the lamplight, and the corner is dark and still again.

pages: A cup clatters somewhere in the café. Mimi is gone before it stops ringing.
A minute later she's back, pretending it didn't happen.

reply: Mimi nods, very slightly, from her corner, as if you had both agreed to forget it.

choices.text: Ask if she's all right, softly
reply: Mimi's ears flick at your voice. She turns her head a little, not quite looking at you.
Mimi's tail puffs up, and she is behind the bookcase before the laugh has finished.

pages: Mimi is watching the pages of your book. Each time one turns, her ears twitch.

reply: Mimi's ears settle, and she watches each page turn with calm, careful interest.
Mimi's ears stay forward, waiting, and she seems almost disappointed when you start again.
Mimi's ears twitch with each page, but she stays where she is, watching.
Mimi's ears go flat, and she slips quietly out of sight.

pages: When the rain gets louder, Mimi tucks herself into a smaller shape.

reply: Mimi stays small and still, but her ears loosen a little, and she breathes easier.
Mimi's head lifts, and she listens to the hum with her eyes half shut, very interested.

choices.text: Drum your fingers along with the rain
reply: Mimi's whole body goes stiff, and she uncurls from her small shape and slips away.

pages: Mimi is sitting behind the lamp on the sideboard, where she thinks nobody can see her.
Most of her is showing.

choices.text: Keep your eyes on your book
reply: Mimi stays hidden behind the lamp, and her tail, very slowly, uncurls.
Mimi's ears give a small flick. She stays put, pleased to be noticed without being looked at.
Mimi's eyes meet yours from behind the lamp, then she quickly looks away.

choices.text: Whisper that you can see her
reply: Mimi scrambles out of the lamplight in one bound and is gone.

pages: Mimi is having breakfast somewhere you can't see. You can hear her crunching, very politely.

reply: The crunching carries on, a little happier now, and Mimi seems grateful to be left alone.

choices.text: Sip your drink just as politely
reply: Mimi's crunching slows, then goes on, neat and polite, in answer to your sip.
Mimi's crunching stops, then starts again, as if she were deciding whether to answer.
The crunching stops at once, and in the quiet you hear a small, polite retreat.

pages: Mimi has been sitting perfectly still for a long time, watching you. You're not sure she's breathing.

reply: Mimi's gaze softens, and she stays perfectly still too, the two of you like a pair of statues.
Mimi's eyes flicker at your breath, and she takes one slow breath of her own.
Mimi's eyes close very slowly, then open again, as if checking you are still there.
Mimi starts, her ears flat, and stops being a statue, quickly, and leaves.

pages: Mimi settles in the cat bed, the one nearest you, and turns her back to you. It's a start.

reply: Mimi's back stays turned, but her tail curls round the edge of the cat bed, quite content.
Mimi's ears flick back at the words, and she turns her head towards you, just a little.
Mimi's ears flatten, and she leaves the cat bed in a rush, not looking back.

pages: Mimi sniffs the air in your direction, carefully, like someone reading a letter.

reply: Mimi sniffs the air a little longer, then settles, as if she had read your reply.
Mimi breathes too, very softly, in time with you, and seems to approve.
Mimi's whiskers twitch at your sniff, and she looks surprised, then pleased.
Mimi flattens against the cushion, startled, and vanishes into the shadows.

pages: Mimi sits at the far end of the sill, watching the lit windows across the street.
Now and then she glances at you.

reply: Mimi glances back at you too, then turns to the windows again, a little closer than before.
Mimi's eyes return to the lit windows beside you, as if you were sharing the view.

choices.text: Move to her end of the window
reply: Mimi's tail flicks, and she slips away from the sill as you move.
Mimi startles at your pointing finger and retreats to the far end of the sill.

pages: Mimi pats your fallen bookmark, then pulls her paw back, startled by her own bravery.

reply: Mimi's pride returns, and she pats the bookmark once more, very carefully this time.

choices.text: Nudge it a little closer to her
reply: Mimi nudges the bookmark closer, then looks at you, pleased with herself.
Mimi snatches her paw back and retreats under the cushion, startled by her own bravery.

pages: Mimi yawns, a tiny pink yawn, and then looks embarrassed about it.

reply: Mimi's yawn comes again, and this time she doesn't look embarrassed at all.
Mimi's whiskers twitch at your smile, and she turns her head towards the window.
Mimi looks away too, politely, and her tail flicks in the direction of your cup.
Mimi's ears flatten at the word, and she hides her face in her paws, mortified.

pages: Mimi watches the snow. Her eyes follow one flake all the way down, then the next.

reply: Mimi's eyes follow the snowflakes down with yours, the two of you quiet together.

choices.text: Tell her softly that it's snow
reply: Mimi's ears turn towards your voice, and she keeps her eyes on the flakes, listening.
Mimi's whole body jerks at the tap, and she flees the sill for the bed.

pages: Each time you turn a page, Mimi comes one step closer. You're on page twelve.

reply: Mimi takes another step, and then another, until she is almost close enough to see the page.

choices.text: Stay on this page a while
reply: Mimi sits back down, a little closer, and waits for you to move on.
Mimi freezes, backs up one step, then another, and sits down far away.

pages: Mimi's tail curls up at the tip, like a question mark.

reply: Mimi's tail uncurls at the tip, and she blinks back at you, slow and careful.
Mimi's tail stays curled, but her ears lift, as though she has understood your nod.
Mimi's tail curls and uncurls, a question you don't answer, and she waits.
Mimi's tail snaps back, and she gives you a deeply offended look before leaving.

pages: Somewhere near you, very faintly, something purrs. Mimi stops the moment you look up.

reply: Mimi's purr stays quiet, and she keeps very still, as if nothing had happened.

choices.text: Keep reading as if you didn't hear
reply: Mimi's purr goes on, very faint, and she doesn't stop again.
Mimi's purr returns, a little louder, and her tail curls up, pleased.
Mimi's purr stops dead, and she slips away without a word, offended.

pages: Mimi is curious about your cup. She stretches her neck as far as it will go, but she won't come any closer.

choices.text: Slide the cup a little her way
reply: Mimi's neck stretches a little further, and she sniffs the cup, delighted but cautious.

choices.text: Tell her softly what's in it
reply: Mimi's ears tilt towards you, listening to the words, and she sits a little straighter.
Mimi keeps her neck stretched out, watching the cup, and doesn't come any closer.

choices.text: Hold it out for her to sniff
reply: Mimi's neck snaps back, and she retreats to the far end of the room.

pages: Mimi brushes past your ankle, very lightly, as if by accident.

reply: Mimi brushes past your ankle again, purring very quietly, and doesn't go far.
Mimi's ears flick, and she looks up at you for a moment before brushing past again.
Mimi jumps back from your hand and slips away under the chair.

pages: Mimi blinks at you twice. The second blink is slower.

reply: Mimi's eyes close and open twice, the second one slower, and she looks very pleased.
Mimi's eyes soften at your smile, and she blinks once more, almost shyly.
Mimi looks startled by the wink, then blinks at you, as if unsure what to make of it.

pages: Mimi sits in the cat bed facing you, paws together, very neat. She looks almost brave.

reply: Mimi blinks back, slowly, and sits a little straighter, very brave indeed.
Mimi glances at your posture and sits up with you, paws together, very proud.

choices.text: Tell her she looks very brave
reply: Mimi's ears go pink at the praise, and she tucks her face into her paws.
Mimi's eyes widen, and she slips out of the cat bed, neat and quick, and out of sight.

pages: Mimi's ear turns towards you whenever you move, even though she's pretending to sleep.

reply: Mimi's ear turns to the small movement, then settles back down, reassured.
Mimi's ear twitches, and she sighs, as if she's been caught out but doesn't mind.
Mimi's ear turns towards the humming, and her tail flicks with it, very slowly.

choices.text: Tap the table to test it
reply: Mimi's ears flatten at the tap, and she quietly leaves her bed.

pages: Mimi sits on the sill and watches the rain. She lets you watch it with her, from your chair.

reply: Mimi's gaze stays on the rain, and her tail curls beside her, content to share the view.

choices.text: Tell her it will stop soon
reply: Mimi's ears turn to you, and she nods, very slightly, as if she hopes you're right.
Mimi's eyes snap to you, and she leaves the sill in one neat, quick movement.

pages: Mimi sniffs the air near your hand. She's thinking about it.

choices.text: Turn your hand palm up, slowly
reply: Mimi's nose twitches, and she steps forward, sniffing your open palm with great care.

choices.text: Leave your hand where it is
reply: Mimi watches your hand a moment longer, then decides to come a little closer.
Mimi backs away from your reaching hand, very quickly, and hides behind the chair.

pages: Mimi is watching the shadow of your cup on the table as the candle flickers. It seems to soothe her.

reply: Mimi's eyes stay on the shadow, and her tail curls round as she relaxes.
Mimi watches the shadow shift with the cup, then settles again, calmer than before.
Mimi's breathing slows, and she keeps her eyes on the shadow, very still beside you.
Mimi's shadow-watching ends abruptly. She bolts off the table, ears flat.

pages: Mimi is asleep nearby. Her paws twitch, and she makes a tiny sound.

reply: Mimi's paws twitch again, and she sleeps on, quite undisturbed, a tiny sound escaping her.
Mimi's ears twitch towards your whisper, and her breathing settles into something very peaceful.
Mimi sighs in her sleep and stretches one paw towards the sound of your page.
Mimi's eyes flicker open, and she slips out of the bed in one quick, offended movement.

pages: Mimi's blue collar has slipped round. She scratches at it, looks at you, then scratches again.

reply: Mimi lifts her chin, eyes half closed, and lets you tuck her collar back into place.

choices.text: Hold out a hand and wait
reply: Mimi considers your hand, then pushes her head towards it, letting you fix the collar.
Mimi scratches the collar once more, then gives up and sits, still scratching a little.
Mimi jerks away from your fingers, the collar still twisted, and she hops off the bed.

pages: You've been humming without noticing. Mimi has noticed. She's listening.

reply: Mimi's eyes close, her ears turned towards the tune, and she lets the humming carry her.
Mimi's ears swivel at the new tune, and she tilts her head, curious and quite pleased.
Mimi's ears stay turned towards where your humming was, waiting for it to start again.
Mimi's ears flatten at the noise, and she slips away, quite cross.

pages: Mimi climbs onto your table, sits by your book and watches you read, very quietly.

reply: Mimi settles by your book, purring softly, watching the words as you read them.
Mimi's eyes half close under your hand, and she curls by the page as if it were hers.
Mimi's ears swivel to the voice, and she listens to every word, eyes narrowed in concentration.

choices.text: Close the book with a snap
reply: Mimi's whole body jolts, and she leaps off the table in one neat, startled jump.

pages: Mimi sits beside your chair and leans, just slightly, against your leg.

reply: Mimi leans harder against your leg, a little warmer and closer now, and sighs.

choices.text: Rest your hand on her back
reply: Mimi's purr starts up beneath your fingers, soft and steady, against your leg.
Mimi slides off your leg at once, ears flat, and sits a little apart.

pages: Mimi makes a small sound at you. Not quite a meow. More of a question.

reply: Mimi's ears lift, and she gives a small, soft reply, as if the question were answered at last.
Mimi blinks slowly back, her tail curling up at the tip, quite content with that answer.
Mimi looks up at you, pleased to be asked, and makes the small sound again, more clearly.
Mimi's ears flatten at the loud meow, and she gives you a wounded look and leaves.

pages: Mimi sits in the lamplight near you. At night her blue eyes look almost violet.

reply: Mimi's eyes shine violet in the lamplight, and she looks down, a little shy but very pleased.
Mimi turns back to the lamplight, her eyes glowing, and leans very slightly towards you.
Mimi squints at the sudden brightness, then leaves the lamplight in a quiet, cross hurry.

pages: Mimi puts one paw on the edge of your chair, then the other. She's deciding.

reply: Mimi climbs carefully onto your chair and settles beside you, tail wrapped neatly round her paws.
Mimi's ears flatten a little, then lift, and she puts her other paw on the chair, very slowly.
Mimi hesitates on the chair edge, then jumps back to the floor, but stays close.
Mimi wriggles away at once, dropping to the floor and disappearing under the table.

pages: Mimi watches the snow settle on the balcony rail, then looks at you, to check you've seen it too.

reply: Mimi's eyes return to the snow on the rail, and she watches it with you, very satisfied.
Mimi's ears flick at your soft words, and she looks back at the rail, quietly pleased.
Mimi listens with her head tilted, as if snow were something she has only just heard of.

choices.text: Open the window to show her
reply: Mimi backs away from the cold air, startled, and retreats to the far end of the sill.

pages: Mimi sniffs the rim of your cup, wrinkles her nose and looks at you, disappointed in your choice.

choices.text: Promise to order better next time
reply: Mimi's nose wrinkles one last time, then she looks at you as if she believes you might keep the promise.
Mimi's whiskers twitch, and she turns her head away, almost smiling at your laugh.
Mimi watches you sip with a judging look, then lowers her head, resigned.
Mimi's eyes widen at the sudden movement, and she slips off the table, offended.

pages: Mimi purrs when you look at her. This time she doesn't stop.

reply: Mimi's purr goes on, steady and warm, and she gazes back at you, eyes half closed.
Mimi's purr catches, then starts again, deeper, as she looks up at you.
Mimi's purr stops in a flash, and she leaves the room with her ears flat.

pages: Mimi comes down from the top of the bookcase one shelf at a time, and settles near you.

reply: Mimi settles by your feet, very neat and happy to be so close.
Mimi's ears lift at the praise, and she blinks, quite proud of her long descent.
Mimi takes her time coming down, shelf by shelf, and seems pleased you are watching.
Mimi freezes halfway down the bookcase, then flees back up to the top in a rush.

pages: Mimi falls asleep near you with her head tucked in. Only her chocolate ears show.

reply: Mimi's breathing slows, and her chocolate ears twitch once more before she is fully asleep.
Mimi shifts closer to the scarf and tucks herself into it, still asleep.
Mimi sighs softly in her sleep and turns her ears to the sound of your pages.
Mimi wakes with a start and slips away, her ears flat, sleep forgotten.

pages: Mimi kneads your lap for a long time before she lies down. She's being very thorough.

reply: Mimi finishes kneading, very thoroughly, then sighs and settles on your lap.
Mimi's purr starts as you stroke her, and she curls up on your lap, perfectly content.
Mimi gives you a small, proud look, then goes back to her thorough kneading.
Mimi tumbles off your lap, startled, and vanishes into the cat bed.

pages: When you move your hand, Mimi follows it with her eyes.

reply: Mimi keeps her chin on your hand and purrs, very quietly, as if she had been waiting.
Mimi leans into your fingers, eyes closed, and purrs a little louder.
Mimi's chin drops off your hand, and she looks up at you, hurt, then slips away.

pages: Mimi rolls onto her back beside you, just for a moment. Then she rolls back, embarrassed.

reply: Mimi gives you a relieved look and rolls back into a neat, quiet curl beside you.

choices.text: Tell her softly that it's all right
reply: Mimi's ears lift, and she rolls onto her back again, just for a moment, purring.
Mimi blinks, embarrassed but pleased, and tucks her paws under her chin.
Mimi jerks upright at once, flattens her ears, and leaves your side without a sound.

pages: Mimi curls up on your table between your cup and your book, as if the space were made for her.

reply: Mimi curls tighter between your cup and book and falls asleep, very content, right where she is.
Mimi's ears go soft under your fingers, and she sinks into her nap on the table.

choices.text: Move your cup to give her room
reply: Mimi watches the cup slide aside, then settles into the new space, purring quietly.

pages: It's late and the café is quiet. Mimi sits with you, both of you looking at the dark window.

reply: Mimi stays by you in the dark, watching the window, and purrs in the quiet.
Mimi's ears turn towards your voice, and she listens to every word of your day.
Mimi's eyes close slowly, and she gives a tiny goodnight chirp in return.
Mimi's ears flatten at the tap, and she slips off to bed with a cross little sigh.

pages: Mimi chirps when you look at her, a small happy sound, and trots over.

Mimi bumps her head into your palm, and then, very carefully, settles at your feet.

pages: Mimi doesn't mind the rain any more, as long as you're here. She sits by your feet and listens.

Mimi arches under your hand and purrs, sitting by your feet, unbothered by the rain.

choices.text: Stamp your feet to warm up
reply: Mimi leaps away from the stamping, ears flat, and goes to hide under the table.

pages: Mimi bumps her head against your hand, very gently, then does it again.

pages: Early in the day the café is quiet, and Mimi is braver. She's sitting right next to your chair.

Mimi sits beside your chair, looking at the empty café, quite content with the silence.
